intro: Felix's Box is a small container of personal belongings belonging to Felix Whindlebolt, a refugee who fled the fall of Gnomeregan. Lost during the frantic evacuation into Dun Morogh, the box was looted by local Frostmane trolls and carried off to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

sections.t: Lost in the Flight from Gnomeregan
p: When radiation flooded Gnomeregan during the failed attempt to purge the trogg menace, Felix Whindlebolt joined the frantic exodus of gnomes into Coldridge Valley. In his desperation to escape the radioactive fumes, Felix dropped his most prized personal possessions and crafting gear along the snowy road. Before he could recover them, indigenous Frostmane trolls plundered the roadside remnants and dragged his box, along with his chest and bucket of bolts, back to their crude settlements southwest of Anvilmar.

Unaccustomed to physical violence and ill-suited for the harsh wilderness of Dun Morogh, Felix was forced to seek the help of passing adventurers in Anvilmar to recover his belongings. Retrieving Felix's Box represents more than just returning a modest container; it restores a piece of normalcy and livelihood to a displaced artisan who lost everything in the catastrophe that consumed his underground homeland.
